sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records list Allison P. Matthews's work for American Fork from fiscal year 2023 through 2024. The latest listed position is Records Specialist.

Her federal complaint says she was hired in November 2022 and that her employment ended in December 2023. The payroll entries are labeled fiscal years 2023 and 2024, which should not be read as exact employment dates.
These years are based on reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. The last payroll entry alone does not confirm when the employment ended.
